tagline: Leading independent petroleum refiner and renewable fuels producer
hero_kpi_rationale: Refining segment margins reflect Valero's core operational performance in crude oil processing and are a key indicator of cyclical profitability in the refining sector
company_description: Valero Energy Corporation manufactures, markets, and sells petroleum-based and low-carbon liquid transportation fuels and petrochemical products in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Latin America, Mexico, Peru, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Refining, Renewable Diesel, and Ethanol. The company produces California Reformulated Gasoline Blendstock for Oxygenate Blending (CARBOB) and Conventional Blendstock for Oxygenate Blending (CBOB) gasolines, CARB diesel, diesel, jet fuel, heating oil, and asphalt; feedstocks; aromatics; sulfur and residual fuel oil; intermediate oils; and sulfur, sweet, and sour crude oils. It sells its refined products through wholesale rack and bulk markets; and through outlets under the Valero, Beacon, Diamond Shamrock, Shamrock, Ultramar, and Texaco brands. The company also owns and operates renewable diesel and ethanol plants, as well as produces and sells renewable diesel, renewable naphtha, and neat sustainable aviation fuel under the Diamond Green Diesel brand name. In addition, it offers ethanol and various co-products, including dry distillers grains, syrup, and inedible distillers corn oil to animal feed

risks.title: Commodity Price Risk
risks.summary: Fluctuations in commodity prices for crude oil, gasoline, diesel, jet fuel, and feedstocks significantly impact profitability. Company uses derivative instruments for hedging.
risks.score_rationale: Valero is heavily exposed to volatility in crude oil, refined product prices, and feedstock costs. This directly impacts refining and renewable diesel segment margins, which are core to the business model. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Regulatory and Compliance Risk
risks.summary: Compliance costs for renewable fuel programs and environmental regulations, including RIN prices and low-carbon fuel mandates, can impact operational efficiency and capital allocation.
risks.score_rationale: Valero faces increasing regulatory requirements for renewable fuel standards (RFS), low-carbon fuel programs, environmental standards, and GHG emissions regulations across multiple jurisdictions. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Interest Rate and Financing Risk
risks.summary: Rising interest rates increase borrowing costs for capital expenditures and refinancing of existing debt obligations.
risks.score_rationale: Interest rate fluctuations affect the cost of borrowing for capital investments and operations, but Valero generates substantial cash flow that mitigates this risk. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Asset Impairment Risk
risks.summary: Changes in market conditions, demand for refined products, or regulatory shifts could trigger further impairment charges on refining assets and require asset retirement obligations.
risks.score_rationale: Recent asset impairment charges at Benicia and Wilmington refineries highlight the risk of stranded assets if market fundamentals deteriorate or transition risks accelerate. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Geopolitical and Supply Chain Risk
risks.summary: Geopolitical conflicts, trade tensions, OPEC+ dynamics, and sanctions on crude oil producing nations affect crude availability, prices, and operational planning.
risks.score_rationale: Global conflicts affect crude oil supply and pricing. Trade restrictions and sanctions can impact feedstock availability and market access. (default score, to be refined)

ai_positioning.summary: Valero Energy Corporation does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K filing for fiscal year 2025.
